data: The kiosk on Torget. Korv me brö, cat treats and trisslotter.
The lake by the village. Cars don't float.
The village square, where every run starts and every arrest ends.
The river through the village, from the north-east past Torget and out west to Lundholmssjön.
Runs Skroten, the scrapyard on Stockarydsvägen. Buys anything that rolls, and most things that don't.
Vrigstad's cats sit by the houses and watch the traffic. Some of them like you.
The lake by the village. Cars don't float.
